title: Seal dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b0c8ff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b0c8ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#8ca6c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#a0b8d8'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#c8daf0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='16' fill='#8ca6c8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='14' fill='#a0b8d8'/>
  <!-- face light patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#c8daf0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='29' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#e0e8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='29' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#e0e8ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#5a7a9e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 39 Q50 43 55 39' fill='none' stroke='#5a7a9e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='38' y1='34' x2='30' y2='32' stroke='#7a9ab8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='37' x2='30' y2='38' stroke='#7a9ab8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='34' x2='70' y2='32' stroke='#7a9ab8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='37' x2='70' y2='38' stroke='#7a9ab8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left flipper raised dancing -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q14 36 18 22 Q22 18 28 26 Q32 36 38 46 Z' fill='#7a94b8'/>
  <path d='M30 48 Q16 38 20 24 Q23 20 27 28 Q31 38 36 46 Z' fill='#92aed0'/>
  <!-- right flipper raised up -->
  <path d='M70 48 Q86 34 82 18 Q78 14 72 22 Q68 34 62 46 Z' fill='#7a94b8'/>
  <path d='M70 48 Q84 36 80 20 Q77 16 73 24 Q69 36 64 46 Z' fill='#92aed0'/>
  <!-- tail flip -->
  <path d='M38 86 Q28 90 24 84 Q30 82 34 84 Q36 84 38 84 Z' fill='#7a94b8'/>
  <path d='M62 86 Q72 90 76 84 Q70 82 66 84 Q64 84 62 84 Z' fill='#7a94b8'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd966'>
    <ellipse cx='22' cy='14' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' transform='rotate(-20 22 14)'/>
    <rect x='24.5' y='8' width='1.5' height='7' rx='0.5'/>
    <ellipse cx='77' cy='10' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' transform='rotate(-20 77 10)'/>
    <rect x='79.5' y='4' width='1.5' height='7' rx='0.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe680'>
    <circle cx='15' cy='55' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='50' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='75' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='78' r='1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
